snippet.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027 Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
PBA Pro Bowling 2027 is coming to Steam, XBOX X|S + Windows, and PS5 on December 17th, 2026! Wishlist the game now and sign up for Alpha testing through the links below:

Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4522670/PBA_Pro_Bowling_2027?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcement_aug26&utm_medium=organic_social

Wishlist on XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/pba-pro-bowling-2027/9nrzpfdw49mw

Wishlist on PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019160

Sign up for Alpha testing! - https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/ZR99R3R

Learn more about the game on our website: https://probowling.com
